titles.th: ไมจัง (3): ฟันโยก

meaning.vi: Chỉ toàn ~, cứ ~ mãi (lặp đi lặp lại).
meaning.my: ~ ပဲ လုပ်နေ။

meaning.vi: Mong sao ~ (ước ao điều gì xảy ra).
meaning.en: I wish ~ would happen / I hope ~.
meaning.th: อยากให้ ~ จัง

meaning.vi: Để ~ (mục đích, mong muốn kết quả).

quiz.ja: ビンくんは、マイちゃんの歯を何みたいと言いましたか。

explain.vi: Bin nói răng chị như cái xích đu.
explain.en: Bin said it was like a swing.
explain.th: เหมือนชิงช้า

quiz.ja: マイちゃんの歯は、いつ抜けましたか。

explain.vi: Khi ăn phở bố nấu bữa tối.
explain.en: While eating Dad's pho at dinner.
explain.my: ညစာစားတုန်း။
explain.th: ตอนกินข้าวเย็น

quiz.ja: 日本では、下の歯をどこに投げますか。

explain.vi: Răng dưới ném lên mái, răng trên ném xuống gầm nhà.
explain.en: Lower teeth onto the roof; upper ones under the house.
explain.zh-Hans: 下牙扔屋顶，上牙扔房子底下。
explain.zh-Hant: 下牙扔屋頂，上牙扔房子底下。

quiz.ja: ベトナムでは、だれにお願いしますか。

explain.vi: Trẻ em Việt xin chuột cho răng chắc.

sentences.ja: マイちゃんの前の歯が、グラグラしています。

furigana.surface: が、グラグラしています。

sentences.romaji: Maichan no mae no ha ga, guragura shiteimasu.

translations.vi: Chiếc răng cửa của Mai-chan đang lung lay.
translations.en: Mai-chan's front tooth is wobbly.
translations.zh-Hans: 小麦的门牙摇摇晃晃的。
translations.zh-Hant: 小麥的門牙搖搖晃晃的。
translations.tl: Umuuga ang ngipin sa harap ni Mai-chan.
translations.pt: O dente da frente de Mai-chan está mole.
translations.my: မိုင်ချန်ရဲ့ ရှေ့သွားက လှုပ်နေတယ်။
translations.th: ฟันหน้าของไมจังโยก

grammarNote.vi: グラグラ = lung lay (từ tượng hình). 「〜しています」: đang ở trạng thái ~.
grammarNote.en: グラグラ = wobbly (mimetic word). 「〜している」 = be in a state of ~.

sentences.ja: 「お母さん、見て。歯がグラグラするよ。」
sentences.romaji: “Okaasan, mite. Ha ga guragura suru yo.”

translations.vi: "Mẹ ơi, nhìn này. Răng con lung lay."
translations.en: "Mom, look. My tooth is wobbling."
translations.tl: "Nay, tingnan mo. Umuuga ang ngipin ko."
translations.pt: "Mãe, olha. Meu dente está mole."
translations.th: "แม่ ดูสิ ฟันโยก"

grammarNote.vi: 見て = nhìn này (nhờ thân mật). 「〜よ」: báo cho biết.
grammarNote.en: 見て = look (casual). 「〜よ」 = telling.

sentences.ja: 「あら、すぐ抜けるわね。」
sentences.romaji: “Ara, sugu nukeru wa ne.”

translations.vi: "Ồ, sắp rụng rồi đấy."
translations.en: "Oh my, it'll come out soon."
translations.tl: "Ay, malapit nang matanggal."
translations.pt: "Ah, vai cair logo."
translations.th: "อ้าว ใกล้หลุดแล้วนะ"

grammarNote.vi: すぐ = ngay, sắp. 抜ける = rụng. 「〜わね」: giọng nữ, nhẹ nhàng.
grammarNote.en: すぐ = soon. 抜ける = come out. 「〜わね」 = soft feminine tone.

sentences.ja: マイちゃんは、ちょっとこわくなりました。

furigana.surface: マイちゃんは、ちょっとこわくなりました。

sentences.romaji: Maichan wa, chotto kowaku narimashita.

translations.vi: Mai-chan thấy hơi sợ.
translations.en: Mai-chan got a little scared.
translations.tl: Medyo natakot si Mai-chan.
translations.pt: Mai-chan ficou com um pouco de medo.
translations.my: မိုင်ချန် နည်းနည်း ကြောက်လာတယ်။
translations.th: ไมจังเริ่มกลัวนิดหน่อย

grammarNote.vi: 「〜くなる」: trở nên ~ (tính từ -い). こわい = sợ.
grammarNote.en: 「〜くなる」 = become ~ (い-adj). こわい = scary.

sentences.ja: 「痛い？ こわいよ。」
sentences.romaji: “Itai? Kowai yo.”

translations.vi: "Có đau không? Con sợ lắm."
translations.en: "Will it hurt? I'm scared."
translations.tl: "Masakit ba? Natatakot ako."
translations.pt: "Dói? Estou com medo."
translations.th: "เจ็บไหม กลัวจัง"

grammarNote.vi: 痛い = đau. Câu hỏi thân mật: chỉ lên giọng, không cần か.
grammarNote.en: 痛い = painful. Casual question: rising tone, no か.
grammarNote.th: คำถามแบบกันเอง

sentences.ja: 「だいじょうぶ。新しい歯が、下で待っているのよ。」
sentences.romaji: “Daijoubu. Atarashii ha ga, shita de matteiru no yo.”

translations.vi: "Không sao. Răng mới đang đợi ở dưới đấy."
translations.en: "Don't worry. A new tooth is waiting underneath."
translations.tl: "Ayos lang. May bagong ngipin na naghihintay sa ilalim."
translations.ne: "केही हुँदैन। नयाँ दाँत तल पर्खिरहेको छ।"
translations.id: "Tidak apa-apa. Gigi baru menunggu di bawah."
translations.pt: "Tudo bem. Um dente novo está esperando embaixo."
translations.my: "ရပါတယ်။ သွားအသစ်က အောက်မှာ စောင့်နေတယ်။"
translations.th: "ไม่เป็นไร ฟันใหม่รออยู่ข้างล่าง"

grammarNote.vi: 「〜ているのよ」: đang ~ đấy (mẹ giải thích dịu dàng).
grammarNote.en: 「〜ているのよ」 = is ~ing, you see (gentle explanation).
grammarNote.th: กำลัง ~ อยู่

sentences.ja: ビンくんが、マイちゃんの口の中を見ました。

furigana.surface: ビンくんが、マイちゃんの

sentences.romaji: Binkun ga, Maichan no kuchi no naka o mimashita.

translations.vi: Bin nhìn vào trong miệng Mai-chan.
translations.en: Bin looked inside Mai-chan's mouth.
translations.zh-Hans: 小宾往小麦嘴里看了看。
translations.zh-Hant: 小賓往小麥嘴裡看了看。
translations.tl: Tiningnan ni Bin ang loob ng bibig ni Mai-chan.
translations.id: Bin melihat ke dalam mulut Mai-chan.
translations.pt: Bin olhou dentro da boca de Mai-chan.
translations.my: ဘင်က မိုင်ချန်ရဲ့ ပါးစပ်ထဲကို ကြည့်တယ်။
translations.th: บินมองเข้าไปในปากไมจัง

grammarNote.vi: 口の中 = trong miệng.
grammarNote.en: 口の中 = inside the mouth.

sentences.ja: 「ほんとうだ！ お姉ちゃんの歯、ブランコみたい！」
sentences.romaji: “Hontou da! Oneechan no ha, buranko mitai!”

translations.vi: "Thật nè! Răng chị như cái xích đu ấy!"
translations.en: "It's true! Your tooth is like a swing, Sis!"
translations.tl: "Totoo nga! Parang duyan ang ngipin mo, Ate!"
translations.pt: "É mesmo! Seu dente parece um balanço!"
translations.my: "တကယ်ပဲ! မမရဲ့သွား ဒန်းလိုပဲ!"
translations.th: "จริงด้วย! ฟันพี่เหมือนชิงช้าเลย!"

grammarNote.vi: 「〜みたい」: giống như ~. ブランコ = xích đu.
grammarNote.en: 「〜みたい」 = like ~. ブランコ = swing.

sentences.ja: 学校でも、マイちゃんは歯をさわってばかりです。

furigana.surface: をさわってばかりです。

sentences.romaji: Gakkou de mo, Maichan wa ha o sawatte bakari desu.

translations.vi: Ở trường, Mai-chan cũng cứ sờ răng suốt.
translations.en: At school, too, Mai-chan kept touching her tooth.
translations.zh-Hans: 在学校，小麦也老是摸牙。
translations.zh-Hant: 在學校，小麥也老是摸牙。
translations.tl: Sa paaralan, panay ang hawak ni Mai-chan sa ngipin.
translations.ne: स्कुलमा पनि माई-चान दाँत मात्र छाम्छिन्।
translations.id: Di sekolah pun, Mai-chan terus memegang giginya.
translations.pt: Na escola também, Mai-chan só mexia no dente.
translations.th: ที่โรงเรียนไมจังก็จับฟันตลอด

grammarNote.vi: 「〜てばかり」: chỉ toàn ~, cứ ~ mãi. さわる = sờ.
grammarNote.en: 「〜てばかり」 = do nothing but ~. さわる = touch.

sentences.ja: 昼ご飯の時間も、ゆっくり食べました。
sentences.romaji: Hiru gohan no jikan mo, yukkuri tabemashita.

translations.vi: Giờ ăn trưa bé cũng ăn thật chậm.
translations.en: At lunchtime, she ate slowly too.
translations.zh-Hans: 午饭时间也吃得慢慢的。
translations.zh-Hant: 午飯時間也吃得慢慢的。
translations.tl: Mabagal din siyang kumain sa tanghalian.
translations.id: Saat makan siang, ia makan pelan-pelan.
translations.pt: No almoço, comeu devagar.
translations.my: နေ့လယ်စာချိန်မှာလည်း ဖြည်းဖြည်း စားတယ်။
translations.th: ตอนกินข้าวกลางวันก็กินช้าๆ

grammarNote.vi: ゆっくり = chậm rãi. 「〜も」: cũng.
grammarNote.en: ゆっくり = slowly.

sentences.ja: 「マイちゃん、きょうはゆっくりだね。」

furigana.surface: 「マイちゃん、きょうはゆっくりだね。」

sentences.romaji: “Maichan, kyou wa yukkuri da ne.”

translations.vi: "Mai-chan, hôm nay cậu ăn chậm ghê."
translations.en: "Mai-chan, you're slow today."
translations.tl: "Mai-chan, ang bagal mo ngayon."
translations.pt: "Mai-chan, hoje você está devagar."
translations.th: "ไมจัง วันนี้กินช้าจัง"

grammarNote.vi: 「〜だね」: ~ nhỉ (nhận xét thân mật).
grammarNote.en: 「〜だね」 = ~, huh (casual remark).

sentences.ja: 「歯がね、グラグラなの。」
sentences.romaji: “Ha ga ne, guragura na no.”

translations.vi: "Răng tớ ấy, đang lung lay."
translations.en: "My tooth, you see, is wobbly."
translations.tl: "Ang ngipin ko kasi, umuuga."
translations.pt: "É que meu dente está mole."
translations.th: "ฟันน่ะ มันโยก"

grammarNote.vi: 「〜ね」 giữa câu: "ấy mà" (thu hút chú ý). 「〜なの」: giải thích (nữ, trẻ em).
grammarNote.en: Mid-sentence 「ね」 = "you see". 「〜なの」 = explaining.

sentences.ja: 「わたしも、先月抜けたよ。ほら。」
sentences.romaji: “Watashi mo, sengetsu nuketa yo. Hora.”

translations.vi: "Tớ cũng rụng răng tháng trước đấy. Này."
translations.en: "Mine came out last month too. Look."
translations.tl: "Natanggal din ang akin noong isang buwan. Tingnan mo."
translations.pt: "O meu caiu mês passado. Olha."
translations.th: "ของฉันก็หลุดเมื่อเดือนที่แล้ว ดูสิ"

grammarNote.vi: 先月 = tháng trước. ほら = này, xem này.
grammarNote.en: 先月 = last month. ほら = look.
grammarNote.my: 先月 = ပြီးခဲ့တဲ့လ။
grammarNote.th: 先月 = เดือนที่แล้ว

sentences.ja: ゆきちゃんの口に、小さい白い歯がありました。
sentences.romaji: Yukichan no kuchi ni, chiisai shiroi ha ga arimashita.

translations.vi: Trong miệng Yuki-chan có một chiếc răng trắng nhỏ.
translations.en: In Yuki-chan's mouth was a small white tooth.
translations.zh-Hans: 小雪嘴里有一颗白白的小牙。
translations.zh-Hant: 小雪嘴裡有一顆白白的小牙。
translations.ko: 유키짱의 입에 작고 하얀 이가 있었습니다.
translations.tl: May maliit na puting ngipin sa bibig ni Yuki-chan.
translations.ne: युकी-चानको मुखमा सानो सेतो दाँत थियो।
translations.id: Di mulut Yuki-chan ada gigi kecil putih.
translations.pt: Na boca de Yuki-chan havia um dentinho branco.
translations.my: ယူကီချန်ရဲ့ ပါးစပ်ထဲမှာ သွားဖြူလေး ရှိတယ်။
translations.th: ในปากยูกิจังมีฟันเล็กๆ สีขาว

grammarNote.vi: Hai tính từ đứng liền trước danh từ: 小さい白い歯.
grammarNote.en: Two adjectives before a noun: 小さい白い歯.
grammarNote.my: နာမဝိသေသန နှစ်ခု။
grammarNote.th: คุณศัพท์สองคำ

sentences.ja: 新しい歯です。
sentences.romaji: Atarashii ha desu.

translations.vi: Là răng mới.
translations.en: It's a new tooth.
translations.tl: Bagong ngipin.
translations.pt: É um dente novo.
translations.my: သွားအသစ်ပါ။
translations.th: ฟันใหม่

grammarNote.vi: 新しい = mới.
grammarNote.en: 新しい = new.

sentences.ja: 「いいなあ。わたしも、早く抜けないかな。」
sentences.romaji: “Ii naa. Watashi mo, hayaku nukenai ka na.”

translations.vi: "Thích thế. Không biết răng mình bao giờ mới rụng nhỉ."
translations.en: "Lucky you. I wonder if mine will come out soon."
translations.zh-Hans: “真好。我的牙什么时候才掉呢。”
translations.zh-Hant: “真好。我的牙什麼時候才掉呢。”
translations.tl: "Buti ka pa. Kailan kaya matatanggal ang akin."
translations.pt: "Que inveja. Será que o meu cai logo?"
translations.my: "အားကျလိုက်တာ။ ငါ့ဟာလည်း မြန်မြန် မကျွတ်ဘူးလား။"
translations.th: "ดีจัง ของฉันจะหลุดเร็วๆ ไหมนะ"

grammarNote.vi: 「〜ないかな」: mong ~ (ước ao). いいなあ = thích thế, ghen tị ghê.
grammarNote.en: 「〜ないかな」 = I wish ~ would. いいなあ = lucky you.

sentences.ja: その夜、家族で晩ご飯を食べました。
sentences.romaji: Sono yoru, kazoku de bangohan o tabemashita.

translations.vi: Tối hôm đó, cả nhà ăn cơm tối.
translations.en: That night, the family ate dinner together.
translations.tl: Nang gabing iyon, naghapunan ang pamilya.
translations.ne: त्यो राति परिवारले बेलुकाको खाना खायो।
translations.pt: Naquela noite, a família jantou.
translations.my: အဲဒီည မိသားစု ညစာ စားတယ်။
translations.th: คืนนั้นทั้งครอบครัวกินข้าวเย็น

grammarNote.vi: 晩ご飯 = cơm tối. その夜 = tối hôm đó.
grammarNote.en: 晩ご飯 = dinner. その夜 = that night.
grammarNote.th: 晩ご飯 = ข้าวเย็น

sentences.ja: マイちゃんの好きな、お父さんのフォーです。
sentences.romaji: Maichan no suki na, otousan no foo desu.

translations.vi: Là món phở bố nấu mà Mai-chan thích.
translations.en: It was Dad's pho, Mai-chan's favorite.
translations.zh-Hans: 是小麦最爱的爸爸做的河粉。
translations.zh-Hant: 是小麥最愛的爸爸做的河粉。
translations.tl: Pho ni Tatay, paborito ni Mai-chan.
translations.pt: O pho do papai, o favorito de Mai-chan.
translations.th: เฝอของพ่อที่ไมจังชอบ

grammarNote.vi: 「〜の好きな〜」: món ~ mà ~ thích (の thay が).
grammarNote.en: 「〜の好きな〜」 = the ~ that ~ likes (の for が).

sentences.ja: マイちゃんは、大きな口を開けて食べました。
sentences.romaji: Maichan wa, ookina kuchi o akete tabemashita.

translations.vi: Mai-chan há to miệng mà ăn.
translations.en: Mai-chan opened her mouth wide and ate.
translations.tl: Ibinuka nang malaki ni Mai-chan ang bibig at kumain.
translations.id: Mai-chan membuka mulut lebar-lebar dan makan.
translations.pt: Mai-chan abriu bem a boca e comeu.
translations.my: မိုင်ချန် ပါးစပ် ကျယ်ကျယ်ဖွင့်ပြီး စားတယ်။
translations.th: ไมจังอ้าปากกว้างแล้วกิน

grammarNote.vi: 「〜て〜」: làm ~ rồi ~. 開ける = mở.
grammarNote.en: 「〜て〜」 = do ~ and then ~. 開ける = open.

sentences.ja: ちょうどそのとき。
sentences.romaji: Choudo sono toki.

translations.vi: Đúng lúc ấy.
translations.en: Just then.
translations.tl: Noon mismo.
translations.pt: Foi então.
translations.my: အဲဒီအချိန်မှာပဲ။
translations.th: ตอนนั้นเอง

grammarNote.vi: そのとき = lúc ấy.
grammarNote.en: そのとき = at that moment.
grammarNote.my: အဲဒီအချိန်။

sentences.ja: ポロッ。
sentences.romaji: Poro.

translations.vi: Lộp!
translations.en: Plop!
translations.tl: Plok!
translations.pt: Plim!
translations.my: ဖုတ်!
translations.th: ป๊อก!

grammarNote.vi: ポロッ = tiếng vật nhỏ rơi ra (từ tượng thanh).
grammarNote.en: ポロッ = sound of something small dropping.

sentences.ja: 何か小さい物が、フォーの中に落ちました。
sentences.romaji: Nanika chiisaimono ga, foo no naka ni ochimashita.

translations.vi: Có một vật gì nhỏ rơi vào bát phở.
translations.en: Something small dropped into the pho.
translations.zh-Hans: 有个小东西掉进了河粉里。
translations.zh-Hant: 有個小東西掉進了河粉裡。
translations.ko: 무언가 작은 것이 쌀국수 안에 떨어졌습니다.
translations.tl: May maliit na bagay na nahulog sa pho.
translations.id: Sesuatu yang kecil jatuh ke dalam pho.
translations.pt: Algo pequeno caiu no pho.
translations.my: တစ်ခုခု သေးသေးလေး ဖိုးထဲ ကျသွားတယ်။
translations.th: มีอะไรเล็กๆ ตกลงไปในเฝอ

grammarNote.vi: 何か = cái gì đó. 落ちる = rơi. 「〜の中に」: vào trong ~.
grammarNote.en: 何か = something. 落ちる = fall.
grammarNote.th: อะไรบางอย่าง

sentences.ja: 「あっ、お姉ちゃんの歯だ！」
sentences.romaji: “A, oneechan no ha da!”

translations.vi: "Á, răng của chị kìa!"
translations.en: "Oh, it's your tooth, Sis!"
translations.tl: "Ay, ngipin mo 'yan, Ate!"
translations.pt: "Ah, é o seu dente, mana!"
translations.th: "อ๊ะ ฟันพี่!"

grammarNote.vi: 「〜だ！」: là ~ đấy (phát hiện).
grammarNote.en: 「〜だ！」 = it's ~! (discovery).

sentences.ja: マイちゃんは、口をさわりました。
sentences.romaji: Maichan wa, kuchi o sawarimashita.

translations.vi: Mai-chan sờ vào miệng.
translations.en: Mai-chan touched her mouth.
translations.tl: Hinawakan ni Mai-chan ang bibig.
translations.pt: Mai-chan tocou a boca.
translations.my: မိုင်ချန် ပါးစပ်ကို စမ်းကြည့်တယ်။
translations.th: ไมจังจับปาก

grammarNote.vi: 「〜をさわる」: sờ ~.
grammarNote.en: 「〜をさわる」 = touch ~.

sentences.ja: 前の歯が、ありません。
sentences.romaji: Mae no ha ga, arimasen.

translations.vi: Răng cửa không còn nữa.
translations.en: Her front tooth was gone.
translations.tl: Wala na ang ngipin sa harap.
translations.pt: O dente da frente não estava mais lá.
translations.th: ฟันหน้าหายไปแล้ว

grammarNote.vi: ありません = không có.
grammarNote.en: ありません = isn't there.

sentences.ja: 「抜けた！ 痛くなかった！」
sentences.romaji: “Nuketa! Itakunakatta!”

translations.vi: "Rụng rồi! Chẳng đau gì cả!"
translations.en: "It came out! It didn't hurt!"
translations.tl: "Natanggal! Hindi masakit!"
translations.pt: "Caiu! Não doeu!"
translations.th: "หลุดแล้ว! ไม่เจ็บเลย!"

grammarNote.vi: 痛くなかった = đã không đau (quá khứ phủ định của tính từ -い).
grammarNote.en: 痛くなかった = didn't hurt (past negative of い-adj).

sentences.ja: 「おめでとう、マイ。またお姉さんになったな。」
sentences.romaji: “Omedetou, Mai. Mata oneesan ni natta na.”

translations.vi: "Chúc mừng con, Mai. Con lại lớn thêm rồi."
translations.en: "Congratulations, Mai. You're even more grown-up now."
translations.tl: "Binabati kita, Mai. Mas dalaga ka na."
translations.pt: "Parabéns, Mai. Está ficando mocinha."
translations.my: "ဂုဏ်ယူပါတယ် မိုင်။ ထပ်ကြီးလာပြီ။"
translations.th: "ยินดีด้วยนะไม โตขึ้นอีกแล้ว"

grammarNote.vi: お姉さんになる = lớn thành chị lớn (khen trẻ con trưởng thành). 「〜な」: (nam) cảm thán.
grammarNote.en: お姉さんになる = become a big girl. 「〜な」 = male exclamation.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: お姉さんになる＝长大了。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: お姉さんになる＝長大了。

sentences.ja: お母さんが、歯をきれいに洗ってくれました。
sentences.romaji: Okaasan ga, ha o kirei ni arattekuremashita.

translations.vi: Mẹ rửa sạch chiếc răng giúp bé.
translations.en: Mom washed the tooth clean for her.
translations.zh-Hans: 妈妈帮她把牙洗干净了。
translations.zh-Hant: 媽媽幫她把牙洗乾淨了。
translations.tl: Hinugasan ni Nanay ang ngipin.
translations.id: Ibu mencucikan gigi itu sampai bersih.
translations.pt: Mamãe lavou o dente bem limpinho.
translations.my: အမေက သွားကို သန့်သန့်ဆေးပေးတယ်။
translations.th: แม่ล้างฟันให้สะอาด

grammarNote.vi: きれいに = sạch sẽ. 洗ってくれる = rửa giúp mình.
grammarNote.en: きれいに = clean. 洗ってくれる = wash for me.

sentences.ja: 「日本では、下の歯は屋根に投げるのよ。」
sentences.romaji: “Nihon de wa, shita no ha wa yane ni nageru no yo.”

translations.vi: "Ở Nhật, răng hàm dưới thì ném lên mái nhà đấy."
translations.en: "In Japan, you throw lower teeth onto the roof."
translations.zh-Hans: “在日本，下面的牙要扔到屋顶上。”
translations.zh-Hant: “在日本，下面的牙要扔到屋頂上。”
translations.tl: "Sa Japan, inihahagis sa bubong ang ngipin sa ibaba."
translations.id: "Di Jepang, gigi bawah dilempar ke atap."
translations.pt: "No Japão, os dentes de baixo vão para o telhado."
translations.th: "ที่ญี่ปุ่น ฟันล่างจะโยนขึ้นหลังคา"

grammarNote.vi: 「〜では」: ở ~ thì. 屋根 = mái nhà. 投げる = ném.
grammarNote.en: 「〜では」 = in ~. 屋根 = roof. 投げる = throw.
grammarNote.my: 屋根 = အမိုး။
grammarNote.th: 屋根 = หลังคา

sentences.ja: 「上の歯は、家の下に投げるの。」
sentences.romaji: “Ue no ha wa, ie no shita ni nageru no.”

translations.vi: "Răng hàm trên thì ném xuống gầm nhà."
translations.en: "Upper teeth go under the house."
translations.tl: "Ang sa itaas, sa ilalim ng bahay."
translations.pt: "Os de cima vão para debaixo da casa."
translations.my: "အပေါ်သွားကို အိမ်အောက် ပစ်တယ်။"
translations.th: "ฟันบนโยนลงใต้ถุนบ้าน"

grammarNote.vi: 上 ⇔ 下: trên ⇔ dưới. 家の下 = gầm nhà.
grammarNote.en: 上 ⇔ 下 = up ⇔ down.

sentences.ja: 「どうして？」
sentences.romaji: “Doushite?”

translations.vi: "Sao lại thế ạ?"
translations.en: "Why?"
translations.tl: "Bakit po?"
translations.pt: "Por quê?"
translations.th: "ทำไมคะ"

grammarNote.vi: どうして = tại sao.
grammarNote.en: どうして = why.

sentences.ja: 「新しい歯が、まっすぐ強く出てくるようにね。」
sentences.romaji: “Atarashii ha ga, massugu tsuyoku detekuru you ni ne.”

translations.vi: "Để răng mới mọc lên thẳng và khỏe đấy."
translations.en: "So the new tooth grows in straight and strong."
translations.zh-Hans: “是为了让新牙长得又直又结实。”
translations.zh-Hant: “是為了讓新牙長得又直又結實。”
translations.tl: "Para tumubo nang diretso at matibay ang bagong ngipin."
translations.ne: "नयाँ दाँत सीधा र बलियो आओस् भनेर।"
translations.id: "Supaya gigi baru tumbuh lurus dan kuat."
translations.pt: "Para o dente novo nascer reto e forte."
translations.my: "သွားအသစ် တည့်တည့် သန်သန် ပေါက်လာအောင်။"
translations.th: "เพื่อให้ฟันใหม่ขึ้นมาตรงและแข็งแรง"

grammarNote.vi: 「〜ように」: để ~ (mục đích). 強く = khỏe (trạng từ).
grammarNote.en: 「〜ように」 = so that ~. 強く = strongly.

sentences.ja: ベトナムでも、同じように歯を投げます。
sentences.romaji: Betonamu de mo, onaji you ni ha o nagemasu.

translations.vi: Ở Việt Nam cũng ném răng giống như vậy.
translations.en: In Vietnam, too, people throw teeth in the same way.
translations.tl: Sa Vietnam, inihahagis din ang ngipin.
translations.ne: भियतनाममा पनि त्यसै गरी दाँत फ्याँकिन्छ।
translations.id: Di Vietnam juga gigi dilempar seperti itu.
translations.pt: No Vietnã também se jogam os dentes assim.
translations.my: ဗီယက်နမ်မှာလည်း အလားတူ သွားကို ပစ်တယ်။
translations.th: ที่เวียดนามก็โยนฟันเหมือนกัน

grammarNote.vi: 同じように = giống như vậy.
grammarNote.en: 同じように = in the same way.

sentences.ja: そして、ネズミに「じょうぶな歯をください」とお願いします。

furigana.surface: そして、ネズミに「じょうぶな

sentences.romaji: Soshite, nezumi ni “Joubu na ha o kudasai” to onegaishimasu.

translations.vi: Và xin chuột: "Cho con chiếc răng thật chắc."
translations.en: And they ask a mouse, "Please give me a strong tooth."
translations.zh-Hans: 还会对老鼠说：“请给我结实的牙。”
translations.zh-Hant: 還會對老鼠說：“請給我結實的牙。”
translations.ko: 그리고 쥐에게 "튼튼한 이를 주세요" 하고 부탁합니다.
translations.tl: At hinihiling sa daga: "Bigyan mo ako ng matibay na ngipin."
translations.ne: अनि मुसासँग "बलियो दाँत देऊ" भनी माग्छन्।
translations.id: Lalu meminta pada tikus, "Beri aku gigi yang kuat."
translations.pt: E pedem ao rato: "Me dê um dente forte."
translations.th: แล้วขอหนูว่า "ขอฟันแข็งแรงหน่อย"

meanings.th: กรุณา, ให้

grammarNote.vi: Ở VN có câu "Chuột ơi, đổi răng". じょうぶ = chắc khỏe. お願いする = nhờ, xin.
grammarNote.en: Vietnamese kids ask a mouse to swap teeth. じょうぶ = sturdy.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: じょうぶ＝结实。お願いする＝请求。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: じょうぶ＝結實。お願いする＝請求。
grammarNote.my: じょうぶ = ခိုင်ခံ့။
grammarNote.th: じょうぶ = แข็งแรง

sentences.ja: マイちゃんの歯は、下の歯でした。
sentences.romaji: Maichan no ha wa, shita no ha deshita.

translations.vi: Răng của Mai-chan là răng hàm dưới.
translations.en: Mai-chan's tooth was a lower one.
translations.tl: Nasa ibaba ang ngipin ni Mai-chan.
translations.pt: O dente de Mai-chan era de baixo.
translations.th: ฟันของไมจังเป็นฟันล่าง

grammarNote.vi: 「〜でした」: quá khứ của です.
grammarNote.en: 「〜でした」 = past of です.
grammarNote.th: อดีตของ です

sentences.ja: マイちゃんは、お父さんと外に出ました。
sentences.romaji: Maichan wa, otousan to soto ni demashita.

translations.vi: Mai-chan cùng bố ra ngoài.
translations.en: Mai-chan went outside with Dad.
translations.zh-Hans: 小麦和爸爸一起到了外面。
translations.zh-Hant: 小麥和爸爸一起到了外面。
translations.tl: Lumabas si Mai-chan kasama si Tatay.
translations.pt: Mai-chan saiu com o papai.
translations.my: မိုင်ချန် အဖေနဲ့ အပြင်ထွက်တယ်။
translations.th: ไมจังออกไปข้างนอกกับพ่อ

grammarNote.vi: 「〜と」: cùng với ~. 外に出る = ra ngoài.
grammarNote.en: 「〜と」 = with ~. 外に出る = go outside.

sentences.ja: そして、「えい！」と屋根に投げました。
sentences.romaji: Soshite, “Ei!” to yane ni nagemashita.

translations.vi: Rồi "hây!" một cái, ném lên mái nhà.
translations.en: Then, with a "Hup!", she threw it onto the roof.
translations.zh-Hans: 然后“嘿！”地一声扔上了屋顶。
translations.zh-Hant: 然後“嘿！”地一聲扔上了屋頂。
translations.tl: At sa "Hup!", inihagis niya sa bubong.
translations.pt: E, com um "Upa!", jogou no telhado.
translations.th: แล้วก็ "ฮึบ!" โยนขึ้นหลังคา

grammarNote.vi: えい = tiếng hô khi dùng sức. 「〜と」: trích dẫn âm thanh.
grammarNote.en: えい = a shout of effort. 「〜と」 quotes a sound.
grammarNote.th: เสียงออกแรง

sentences.ja: 「ネズミさん、じょうぶな歯をください！」
sentences.romaji: “Nezumisan, joubu na ha o kudasai!”

translations.vi: "Chuột ơi, cho con chiếc răng thật chắc nhé!"
translations.en: "Mr. Mouse, please give me a strong tooth!"
translations.tl: "G. Daga, bigyan mo ako ng matibay na ngipin!"
translations.pt: "Seu Rato, me dê um dente forte!"
translations.th: "คุณหนู ขอฟันแข็งแรงด้วยนะ!"

grammarNote.vi: 「〜さん」 gắn cả cho con vật (thân thương). 「〜をください」: xin cho ~.
grammarNote.en: 「〜さん」 used even for animals. 「〜をください」 = please give me ~.

sentences.ja: 「ぼくの歯も、早く抜けないかな。」
sentences.romaji: “Boku no ha mo, hayaku nukenai ka na.”

translations.vi: "Răng em bao giờ mới rụng nhỉ."
translations.en: "I wish my tooth would come out soon too."
translations.tl: "Sana matanggal na rin ang ngipin ko."
translations.pt: "Tomara que o meu caia logo."
translations.th: "ฟันผมจะหลุดเร็วๆ ไหมนะ"

grammarNote.vi: ぼく = tớ, em (con trai tự xưng).
grammarNote.en: ぼく = I (used by boys).

sentences.ja: ビンくんは、自分の歯を指でおしました。
sentences.romaji: Binkun wa, jibun no ha o yubi de oshimashita.

translations.vi: Bin lấy ngón tay ấn vào răng mình.
translations.en: Bin pushed on his own tooth with his finger.
translations.zh-Hans: 小宾用手指按了按自己的牙。
translations.zh-Hant: 小賓用手指按了按自己的牙。
translations.tl: Tinulak ni Bin ang sariling ngipin gamit ang daliri.
translations.id: Bin menekan giginya sendiri dengan jari.
translations.pt: Bin empurrou o próprio dente com o dedo.
translations.my: ဘင်က ကိုယ့်သွားကို လက်ချောင်းနဲ့ ဖိတယ်။
translations.th: บินใช้นิ้วกดฟันตัวเอง

meanings.my: လက်ချောင်း
ကိုယ်တိုင်

grammarNote.vi: 自分の = của chính mình. 「〜で」: bằng ~. おす = ấn.
grammarNote.en: 自分の = one's own. おす = push.

sentences.ja: 「……ぜんぜん動かない。」
sentences.romaji: “...... Zenzen ugokanai.”

translations.vi: "...Chẳng nhúc nhích tí nào."
translations.en: "...It won't budge at all."
translations.tl: "...Hindi gumagalaw."
translations.pt: "...Não mexe nada."
translations.th: "...ไม่ขยับเลย"

meanings.th: เคลื่อนไหว

grammarNote.vi: 「ぜんぜん〜ない」: hoàn toàn không ~. 動く = cử động.
grammarNote.en: 「ぜんぜん〜ない」 = not ~ at all. 動く = move.

sentences.ja: みんなは、また笑いました。
sentences.romaji: Minna wa, mata waraimashita.

translations.vi: Mọi người lại phá lên cười.
translations.en: Everyone laughed again.
translations.tl: Nagtawanan ulit ang lahat.
translations.pt: Todos riram de novo.
translations.my: အားလုံး ထပ်ရယ်ကြတယ်။
translations.th: ทุกคนหัวเราะอีกครั้ง

grammarNote.vi: また = lại.
grammarNote.en: また = again.
